correctness.rationale: C PASS: The specified Minkowski-sum pellytope P_n has simplicial normal fan constructed by a stellar subdivision of one 2-cone in Sigma_{n-1} x Sigma_1; crucial endpoint-ray link is Sigma_{n-2}, as in the cited 2024 source. Subdivision removes z^2 C_link and adds z(1+2z)C_link, so F_n=(1+2z)F_{n-1}+z(1+z)F_{n-2}, F0=1,F1=1+2z. Domino placements give closed F_n and simple-polytope h-transform gives gamma_j=binom(n-j,j). The path n-vertex matching polynomial has roots expressed via 2cos(j*pi/(n+1)), yielding the exact h factorization and n pairwise simple negative roots, including -1 once for odd n. The inspected checker independently enumerates chord-compatible cones in n<=7 and asserts recurrence through n=50; direct recurrence coefficient checks corroborate, while the arbitrary-dimensional argument uses the source fan-link theorem.
